subject: Geography
description: Iron-steel locations, cotton textile, sugar belt, IT clusters, automotive hubs

questions.stem: India's first iron and steel plant in the modern era — Tata Iron and Steel Co. (TISCO) — was set up in 1907 at:
questions.explanation: Tata Iron and Steel Co. (TISCO, now Tata Steel) — incorporated 1907 by Jamsetji Tata; first ingot rolled February 1912 at Sakchi, Bihar. Sakchi renamed Jamshedpur (1919) after Jamsetji's death. Located at confluence of Subarnarekha + Kharkai — proximity to iron ore (Mayurbhanj/Singhbhum), coal (Jharia), water, port (Calcutta). Other public-sector steel plants — Rourkela (1959, Odisha, German collaboration), Bhilai (1959, Chhattisgarh, Soviet), Durgapur (1959, WB, British), Bokaro (1972, Jharkhand, Soviet), Salem (TN), Vizag (AP), Vijayanagar (Bellary, Karnataka). SAIL (Steel Authority of India Ltd) — 1973.

questions.stem: India's COTTON textile industry historically concentrated in:
questions.explanation: First Indian cotton mill: Bombay Spinning Mill (1854) by Cawasji Davar, Mumbai. Mumbai-Ahmedabad belt led the industry through 19th-20th century — proximity to cotton belt (Maharashtra-Gujarat black soil), port access (Mumbai), capital (Parsis, Marwaris), labour. Also Coimbatore (TN) — 'Manchester of South India'. Modern industry has spread — Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Andhra. India is world's #1 cotton producer (some years) + 2nd largest exporter of cotton textiles. Jute industry, by contrast, was concentrated in Bengal (Hooghly basin).

questions.stem: The 'Detroit of India' — major automotive manufacturing hub — is:

options.option_text: Chennai (Sriperumbudur, Oragadam — Hyundai, Ford, Renault-Nissan, BMW, Daimler, Royal Enfield)

questions.explanation: Chennai — 'Detroit of India' for the dense cluster of auto OEMs + suppliers. Hyundai (largest passenger-car exporter from India), Ford India (closed 2021), Renault-Nissan, BMW, Daimler/Mercedes, Royal Enfield (Tiruvottiyur), Ashok Leyland, TVS Motors. Pune — 'Manchester of East' / 2nd auto cluster (Tata Motors, Bajaj Auto, Mahindra, Mercedes-Benz, Volkswagen India). Delhi-NCR — Maruti-Suzuki Gurgaon/Manesar, Honda Cars Greater Noida, Hero MotoCorp. Bengaluru — Toyota Kirloskar, Volvo. New EV cluster around Sanand (Gujarat) post Tata Nano + Tesla. India was world's 3rd largest auto market (passenger vehicles) in 2022.

options.option_text: Uttar Pradesh — vast sugar belt across Doab

questions.explanation: UP — largest sugar producer historically (long stable yield, traditional jaggery industry, dense Doab cane). Maharashtra (sugar cooperatives — Pune-Kolhapur belt) sometimes overtakes UP in lean monsoon years. Top 3: UP, Maharashtra, Karnataka (~80% of total). Sugarcane requires 75-150 cm rainfall + 21-27 °C — suits subtropical North India + Deccan plateau. India is world's 2nd largest sugar producer (after Brazil) and largest consumer. Surplus exported (~7-8 MT in 2024-25). Ethanol blending push (E20 by 2025) is diverting cane to ethanol production.

questions.stem: India's IT services hub — often called 'Silicon Valley of India' — is:
questions.explanation: Bengaluru — Silicon Valley of India. Started with public-sector defense + electronics (HAL, ISRO, BEL) + IISc + IT cluster (Electronic City, Whitefield, Outer Ring Road). HQ for Infosys, Wipro, Tech Mahindra. R&D centers for Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Goldman Sachs. Flipkart, Ola, Swiggy started here. Other IT hubs: Hyderabad (HITEC City — Microsoft, Facebook, Amazon, Google), Pune (TCS HQ, Infosys, Persistent), Chennai (Tidel Park, Cognizant, Zoho), Noida-Gurugram (HCL, Adobe, GENPACT). India's IT-ITES exports ~$190 B (FY 2024-25).

questions.stem: The pharmaceutical industry's biggest cluster in India is in:

options.option_text: Hyderabad-Telangana ('Bulk Drug Capital of India') + Mumbai-Goa-Maharashtra belt

questions.explanation: Hyderabad — 'Bulk Drug Capital' (Genome Valley, Hyderabad Pharma City, Bharat Biotech, Dr Reddy's, Aurobindo, Divi's). Mumbai cluster — Sun Pharma, Cipla, Lupin, Glenmark, USV. Goa hub — drug manufacturing (Glenmark, Cipla). Ahmedabad-Vadodara — Zydus, Torrent. Sikkim — small molecule API tax-incentive cluster (post-2003 SEZ). India is the 'Pharmacy of the World' — supplies ~50% of global generic drugs by volume; #3 by value. ~70% of WHO's vaccine production. India's pharma exports ~$28 B in 2024.

questions.stem: India's largest oil refinery (single location, by capacity) is:

options.option_text: Jamnagar (Reliance Industries) — combined ~1.36 million bpd; world's largest refining complex

questions.explanation: Jamnagar (Gujarat) — Reliance Industries' integrated refinery complex (DTA + SEZ refineries combined). Total capacity ~1.36 million barrels/day — world's LARGEST refining complex at a single location. India is the 4th largest refiner globally (~5 million bpd total). Other major refineries: Paradip (Odisha, IOCL), Mathura (IOCL), Mumbai (BPCL + HPCL), Vizag (HPCL), Mangalore (MRPL). India is a net exporter of petroleum PRODUCTS even though it imports 85% of its crude. India's refining capacity is being expanded to 450 MMTPA by 2030.
